title: KS-602 (BM-1): Is the certification model final, and do we plan its build now?
bluf: The ticket records, from the 2026-08-11 technical weekly (Stuart, Phil, Kam): certification = attestation + signing + optional watermarking; ANY modification (including watermarking) creates a NEW document version and requires mandatory re-certification. It is likely an epic (data model, lineage enforcement, re-certification triggers, API/spec). 0 comments; no build exists. Ticket says it is split into sub-tickets 'when the build starts'. Whether you confirm it as the spec of record, and whether planning starts, is the ruling. Building it changes production data model and API.
